scientific_integrity: All-dimensional proof combines averaging, quotient duality, analytic Fourier bounds, a verified exact finite rational certificate, and compact-uniform Riemann sums. The finite certificate covers n=5..20 except eight; larger dimensions use the analytic bound. The same-model review is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Real scalar Lipschitz functions on unweighted unit-edge finite cycles; first two harmonic pairs only. Higher bandwidths, weighted cycles and complex spaces are not covered. Published-priority assessment may miss older unindexed terminology.
title: Eight-cycle resonance in degree-two Lipschitz Fourier projection
